scripts.check:api:build: tsc src/lib/api.ts --outDir .contract/api --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node -e "require('node:fs').renameSync('.contract/api/api.js', '.contract/api/api.mjs')"
scripts.check:source-import: tsc src/lib/api.ts src/lib/sourceImport.ts --outDir .contract/source-import --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node scripts/check-source-import.mjs
scripts.check:api:local: npm run check:api:build && node scripts/check-api-contract.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3101 local
scripts.check:api:local-nostore: npm run check:api:build && node scripts/check-api-contract.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3101 local-nostore
